text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, we held a joint training session with Symboli Rudolf,
focusing mainly on tandem running drills.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Today was fun.
Thank you, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—C.B.
It seems the quality of your running has changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She felt even lighter on her feet and tougher than the CB from before.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then maybe it has changed.
...Why do you think that is?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. While her efforts under the guidance and planning
of her dedicated trainer surely play a part—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The primary reason is—mind and body as one. Isn't it something far more fundamental than that?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—I wonder what you thought of it, Trainer?
About what I was talking with Rudolf about earlier.”
choice_data_list: I think your ability is definitely growing.
I think your ability is definitely growing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you.
Still, if things have truly changed――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —I think it's more about mental attitude.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Running under a Trainer only ever felt suffocating to me.
Well, that was until now, at least.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If anything, it made me
feel so much freer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just run because it's fun.
Both training and racing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Hearing your answer...
really cleared things up for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then.
I haven't had enough fun for today just yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a break, Mr. C.B. began running once more.
With a brilliant, breathtaking run
that couldn't help but inspire dreams.
